$comment: Alt text, caption, and kind for every screenshot slot a generated lab can contain, keyed by the slot's filename. Slots themselves (filename, section, capture instructions) live in features.json, and in tools/feature-tour/overlay.json for features the catalog gives none. Alt text describes what the captured image will show and why it matters to the step, in one or two sentences, and never starts with 'Screenshot of' or 'Image of'. It states state and text, not color alone. kind is one of ui-location (where something lives), dialog (a dialog or panel), settings (a settings page), before (state before a change), after (state after a change), test-result (a test conversation or run result), or error-state. A slot is decorative only when it carries no information; none of these are. validateScreenshotSlots() requires an entry for every slot and checks alt quality. Use US English.
